title: Frequent Shopper Reduction on the Marlowe & Finch Alterations Deposit Rate
content:
A frequent-shopper deposit reduction is taken off the deposit rate of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket from the customer's Marlowe & Finch order payments dated less than 12 whole months before today.

| Order payments dated less than 12 whole months before today | Frequent-shopper reduction |
|---|---|
| five or more | 5 percentage points |
| two to four | 2 percentage points |
| one or none | none |

**Records read.** The payment entries on the customer's Merchandise Purchases records and their dates. Each payment entry counts once.

## Thresholds, both sides

| Payments in the window | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1 | none |
| 2 | 2 percentage points |
| 4 | 2 percentage points |
| 5 | 5 percentage points |

A payment dated 12 whole months or more before today is outside the count.

## Hypothetical illustration

A customer with order payments dated 1, 3, 6 and 11 months ago and one dated 14 months ago has four payments in the window: 2 percentage points.
